title: Left rail 'Your Circles' lists only Circles the member runs
detail: Owner ruling 2026-11-13: the rail shows the Circles a member hosts (host seat or circles.host_id), not ones they merely joined. Fixed in lib/nav/my-frequency.ts; lib/nav/my-frequency.seeded.test.ts proves a joined-only Circle is dropped.

verify.evidence: lib/nav/my-frequency.seeded.test.ts: a joined-only Circle (volunteer_role null, not host_id) is absent from the rail menu; run in CI as part of the test job.
